title: party artefact
description: One signed file per party (policy-composition ticket 11, spec.md 'The party artefact'; ADR-0012, ADR-0013). Declares the party's name, its roles, its parents as party+kind+version, its selected baseline name, and its overlay. Promoted from the shape spikes/cs-06b-cross-party-composition/material/parties/*.yaml proposed. The single source of truth for the allowed roles and parent kinds -- party_artefact.py reads its enums from this file rather than re-declaring them.

party.description: The party this artefact declares, e.g. 'driftwood'.

roles.description: CONTEXT.md's Role entry. Roles compose; this is not a partition.

baseline.description: The named baseline this party selects from its controls parent, e.g. 'MODERATE'. May be widened by an overlay add, never narrowed (ADR-0013).

inherits.description: Every parent this party pins, as party+kind+version. The version is the tag this party already pins in its own Flux/Renovate files.

kind.description: controls: a catalogue + named baselines. implementations: policy bodies + control claims. pricing: a penalty schema, no rules. threat: a feed, no rules.

add.description: Members this party ships itself, versioned with its own composed artefact.

restate.description: An inherited ValidatingPolicy and the action this party wants for it. Stricter is accepted; weaker is a declared inability, caged and priced, never an override.

controls.description: Bare catalogue control ids (ticket 14; ADR-0013, ADR-0017) this party adds to its selected baseline, beyond what the baseline name already selects. May only grow: a composition refuses on any id that leaves the last signed composed artefact's selected set. Optional; defaults to none.
